messages:
emma (sales): Heads up — customer (Acme Health) asked for SIG/CAIQ details for the POC. They're specifically worried about data classification and KMS boundaries. Can @ravi or @olivia weigh in? TL;DR: they need to know who manages encryption at rest, key rotation, and logs in Private vs Dedicated.

ravi (security): I can take first pass. Main split: Redwood handles model runtime encryption at rest and in-transit. Customer manages application data before ingestion and KMS for BYOK in Private. @jack can you confirm legal notes for BYOK?

olivia (solutions): Adding: For Dedicated (reserved capacity) we control host-level disk encryption; customer can choose to enable KMS for key material via our KMS-integration. For Private (VPC/on-prem), they control KMS/HSM endpoints. Will draft short matrix.

emma (sales): Perfect. Could you add specifics for logs/audit retention and access? Acme wants 7y retention for audit trails.

ravi (security): Short: We retain platform logs 90d by default. Enterprise add-on supports customizable retention up to 7y (paid). Access: role-based in Console; audit logs exported to customer S3/BigQuery in Private. I'll put exact CAIQ control IDs: CCM-06, LOG-02 in the draft.

jack (legal): Confirm legal: BYOK means customer key ownership but we still need emergency access clause for incident response — standard in our T&Cs. Also need to ensure their SOC2 wording doesn't assume we access data.

olivia (solutions): Draft matrix snippet (will paste into CAIQ doc):
```json
{"scope":"Hosted","encryption_at_rest":"Redwood-managed (AES-256)","kms":"Redwood KMS (customer-managed on request for Dedicated)","logs":"Platform logs stored encrypted; export available"}
```

emma (sales): Nice. Can you also call out where we take responsibility for model artifacts (weights) vs customer prompt data? Customer worried about IP of prompts.

ravi (security): @emma: Responsibility: model artifacts = Redwood (we serve models). Prompt/input data from customer = customer-owned. For hosted API we do cache prefixes for performance but cache TTLs are per-tenant and not accessible cross-tenant. We'll add that under 'Data Segregation' (CAIQ DS-01).

olivia (solutions): I'll attach a short note about canary fallbacks and what happens if model variant falls back to lower-capacity host — no data movement outside customer's region. Adding to CAIQ section 'System Resilience / Data locality'.

emma (sales): Great. Could someone commit the CAIQ answers to the shared doc and ping Acme? I want to include pricing note for Dedicated KMS add-on.

olivia (solutions): Will do. Pinging @ravi @jack once posted. ETA 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shared/doc/ca iq-updates published by olivia at 2024-09-12T15:12:03Z

emma (sales): Thanks — I'll follow up with Acme and confirm POC milestones.
